title: Recorded UK imports: milk products (not cheese) (HS 0401–0405)
coverage: UK recorded imports from all partners (EU and non-EU import flows); GB and Northern Ireland
attribution: Source: HMRC Overseas Trade Statistics (uktradeinfo). Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

retrieval.method: HMRC OTS API, server-side $apply aggregation; raw responses cached in pipeline/raw/hmrc/
retrieval.source: 14 queries over consecutive runs of the basket's CN8 codes (URL length), first: https://api.uktradeinfo.com/OTS?$apply=filter(MonthId%20ge%20201901%20and%20(FlowTypeId%20eq%201%20or%20FlowTypeId%20eq%203)%20and%20(CommodityId%20eq%204011010%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%204011090%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%204012011%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%204012019%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%204012091%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%204012099%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%204013011%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%204013019%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%204013031%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%204013039))/groupby((MonthId,FlowTypeId,CountryId,CommodityId,SuppressionIndex),aggregate(NetMass%20with%20sum%20as%20SumNetMass,Value%20with%20sum%20as%20SumValue,$count%20as%20Rows))
